key_idea: Only 50 instructions and 2 alternatives each, so try every single substitution in line order and simulate.
sketch: For each line i from 1 to n and each of the two other instruction words, replace it, simulate the walk from (0,0) facing north (direction index with Left = -1, Right = +1 mod 4), and print the first substitution that lands on the target. O(n^2) with n<=50. Pitfalls: iterate lines in increasing order so the earliest fix is reported, and skip the substitution equal to the original instruction.
